title: Construction documentation and drawing production on the verified CAD/BIM product
objective: Extend the verified CAD/BIM product (Architecture v1.1, post COMPAT-CAD-002) into construction-documentation workflows without leaving the shared CADDocument/App API/Construction Graph boundaries: drawing views derived from the BIM model (orthographic plans, elevations, sections and detail views with viewport state), dimensions/tags/annotations associated with canonical element identities, sheets/layouts/title blocks, deterministic view regeneration after model changes, immutable/replayable/persisted documentation revisions, Web/Electron parity for equivalent semantic drawing results, and export contracts for future PDF/DWG documentation adapters without committing to proprietary writers. The acceptance bar is the actual documentation workflow with deterministic assertions, not a visual mockup.
acceptance_criteria: A representative building model can generate plan, elevation and section views through the shared App API in both hosts.
Dimensions/annotations remain associated with canonical element IDs (typed dangling reporting on reference loss; no silent re-targeting).
Model changes deterministically regenerate affected documentation (re-projection and annotation value refresh are pure functions of the model; identical inputs produce identical view content hashes).

Documentation revisions are immutable, replayable and persisted (view/sheet/annotation edits and regeneration value updates flow through the existing versioned command model and model history; save/open preserves them with identical content/history hashes).
Sheets/layouts/title blocks place views deterministically; the sheet export IR is a canonical deterministic artifact (the future PDF/DWG adapter contract).
Web and Electron produce equivalent semantic drawing results through their real transports (same view content hashes, same export IR hashes).
Existing 2D drafting, real-engine and BIM suites remain green (no regression).
New deterministic documentation tests are reproducible in CI.
Unsupported documentation/export operations (e.g. PDF/DWG writers, aligned-dimension modes outside the declared vocabulary) fail explicitly with typed errors; no silent approximation.
No protected architecture paths are modified.
non_goals: Production PDF/DWG writer implementation (export contracts only).
Project/scheduling implementation or research (explicitly deferred by the Architect).
Hidden-line removal or photorealistic rendering in elevations/sections (projected outlines are drawn wireframe; documented).
Cross/aligned dimension modes beyond the declared axis-aligned overall/clear vocabulary.
IFC documentation property sets (COMPAT-IFC-001 remains downstream).
Approval or verification claim by implementation.

Design decision (documentation revision model): view definitions, sheets and documentation annotations are VERSIONED document content through additive DocumentEdit types and annotation-kind elements — their lineage flows through the existing immutable model history. Projected primitives are DERIVED state, never stored: every view projection is a pure deterministic function of (view definition, current BIM elements) recomputed on demand; regeneration refreshes stored annotation values through one atomic versioned batch. Determinism is proven by re-computation (same inputs -> identical canonical view content hashes), not by trusting cached output.

Design decision (elevation/section fidelity): elevations draw projected outlines of all walls/slabs/openings without hidden-line removal; sections draw the projected outlines of elements intersecting the cut plane (cut profiles are projected outlines; filled cut hatching is a rendering concern). Both are documented limitations of this slice, honestly represented — no occlusion is inferred or approximated.

Deployable host proofs on the implementation head: Web lint/typecheck/build clean + the full CI documentation smoke verified locally end-to-end against the running dev server on the real engine (exact primitive counts/bbox/content hashes, parametric dims 5300/4700 -> 5800 after move -> 5300 after undo, byte-identical sheet-IR hash on repeated export, frame 841x594 with 200mm title-block strip, typed pdf/dwg/overlap/removeView rejections, save/open identity + no-op regeneration after open, zero console errors in the browser check); Electron typecheck/build clean + smoke:docs 12/12 PASS run twice with byte-identical hashes across processes (plan 3e1deec9..., sheet-IR a619f4e66d185541..., events 8e21993b8bed43e6...) + all five regression smokes green (smoke, geometry on the real OCCT engine, model, drafting, bim).
